description:
Pre-existing rustdoc warning in pkix-profiles-cabf/src/lib.rs around line 339 (was 330 before PKIX-jbvb.9.5 added new content above it):

```
error: unresolved link to `Self::lint_runner`
   --> pkix-profiles-cabf/src/lib.rs:339:37
    |
339 |     /// produced by [`lint_runner`][Self::lint_runner]: each call to
    |                                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the struct `WebPkiProfile` has no field or associated item named `lint_runner`
```

WebPkiProfile has no `lint_runner` *inherent* method — `lint_runner` is a trait method on `pkix_lint::LintProfile` which WebPkiProfile implements. `Self::lint_runner` is unresolvable via intra-doc-link.

Fix: change to `[`lint_runner`](#method.lint_runner)` or `<Self as pkix_lint::LintProfile>::lint_runner` or just plain backticks. Blocks workspace RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings from going clean.

Probably present in the original `pkix-jbvb.7` shipping commit. Touched up rather than fixed during PKIX-jbvb.9.5 (Individual Multipurpose) because out of scope for that bead.
title: pkix-profiles-cabf: fix broken intra-doc link [`lint_runner`][Self::lint_runner] on WebPkiProfile
